name: Homebridge
author: Ian Swope
description: Control the HomeKit accessories your Homebridge bridges, from the Omarchy bar: a live count of what is on, and one click to toggle any light, switch or outlet — or dim a light — without opening an app.

barWidget.description: Your Homebridge accessories in the bar: a live count of what is on, one click to toggle any light, switch or outlet, and a slider to set a dimmable light's brightness. Talks to Homebridge over its local API with a dedicated, non-admin user.

schema.label: Show the number of devices that are on
